name: pico-spatial-mcp
description: MCP server that compiles natural-language briefs into native PICO OS 6 / Spatial SDK apps and VERIFIES them by capturing frames and looking: 214 tools spanning brief-to-APK compilation (native + WebSpatial lanes), vision-verified honesty (trust ledger + hermetic eye), Gaussian-splat world models with semantic labeling, emulator/device automation, agent-vault SDK symbol validation (vault_api + preflight lint), and PICO's official pico-cli perf diagnosis. Complements PICO's pico-spatial-agentic-tools plugin: install both — theirs guides the agent with skills + SDK knowledge, this one gives the agent a verified build/verify/ship toolchain.
